primary_hardware: owner RTX 4070 Laptop GPU 8 GiB, system RAM measured
optional_portability: larger machines and explicitly authorized hosted APIs; not an extra required phase

phases.name: Efficient 8 GiB image generation and useful batches
Reproducible LoRA/style and private appearance experimentation

milestones.title: Verified installable application foundation
milestones.objective: Installable local Python CLI, validated input safety, synthetic zero-cost batch, persistent journal, reports and CI demonstration; NOT a verified local model-quality or GPU performance claim
milestones.next_action: Maintained infrastructure; no immediate feature work

milestones.title: Research decision: model and runtime on 8 GiB
milestones.objective: Choose one lawful real model/graph and reproducible comparison plan; no claim of model compatibility before an observed run.
milestones.next_action: Compare ComfyUI + fal.ai typed contracts with a reproducible model choice

milestones.title: 8 GiB reproducible baseline
milestones.objective: Obtain correctly authorized, independently inspected repeatability evidence on the current laptop; no generic GPU-tier claim.
milestones.next_action: Separate consent needed for physical three-run benchmark

milestones.title: Measure one useful optimization
milestones.objective: Determine whether one backend-supported change improves a predeclared memory/time objective without unacceptable image loss.
milestones.next_action: Profile only after accepted real baseline

milestones.title: Useful 10-image batch
milestones.objective: Install and run a local generation -> inspect/select -> export path on the owner's real system with receipt-bound failure handling.
milestones.next_action: Close the first real ten-image local batch and resume path

milestones.title: Human-accepted local workflow
milestones.objective: Demonstrate a reviewed accepted-image yield and clear resource/recovery report with realistic install instructions and licence boundaries.
milestones.next_action: Human acceptance of images, cutouts and installation

milestones.title: Research: LoRA and conditioning options
milestones.objective: Choose legal, locally feasible LoRA and subject-conditioning methods from actual backend capabilities.
milestones.next_action: Research lawful local adapters when Phase 1 evidence permits

milestones.title: Reproducible style and LoRA variation
milestones.objective: Produce a pinned, controllable experiment grid where each variation has traceable model/LoRA state and measured memory cost.
milestones.next_action: Implement then measure same model, adapters and seeds

milestones.title: Private appearance experimentation
milestones.objective: Safely create and review controlled personal-reference variations locally without claiming accurate real-life prediction.
milestones.next_action: Consented local reference and human consistency checks

tasks.acceptance: Independent review of real receipt, run provenance, outcomes, peak sampling limitations, safety/rights and whether the specific 8 GiB configuration is actually repeatable.

tasks.acceptance: Expose minimal pip-installable local recipe run -> manual selection -> ZIP/report for 10 real generated images without manual source edits or a new graph editor.
Implement/verify bounded journal resume, interruption handling, model/source identity and no silent re-generation of completed items for this small batch.
Run a separately authorized 10-image local batch on 8 GiB laptop; retain exact recipe, failures/retries, time, peak sampled resource use, output hashes and candidate gallery.
tasks.blocker: Separate owner authorization and a real-machine evidence receipt required

tasks.acceptance: Human-score the real 10-image batch against success criteria recorded before its run; disclose accepted yield, quality failure modes and seconds per accepted image. Compare practical Prehnite value against the same ComfyUI-only work (manual steps, reproducible selection/resume), without claiming image quality speedups that actually come from changed model settings.

Accept/reject documented local install instructions, checkpoint/LoRA rights and honest limitations; explicitly separate this local product acceptance from the old 90-image/paid-billing release obligations.
Choose one legal compatible local base model and LoRA combination; research scale/order/loading, measured-memory requirements, provenance and source license.
Approve controlled style and user-reference editing experiments and privacy boundaries; identify what identity consistency tests can and cannot prove.
Pin base/LoRA hashes, scales, prompt/seeds and backend compatibility in recipe/journal; refuse missing/changed adapter files.
Generate a controlled local parameter grid/contact sheet where one studied dimension changes at a time; preserve all provenance.
Run owner-authorized multiple-seed style experiments on 8 GiB GPU; measure memory/load latency and blind human consistency rating.
tasks.blocker: Separate owner authorization and a real-machine evidence receipt required

tasks.acceptance: Provide local-only opt-in self-owned reference import, no implicit uploads, no mandatory external account and explicit original-image retention policy.
Run a small approved set of haircut/beard/hair-color variations with locally stored inputs; preserve source model/LoRA/edit-strength/seed provenance.
tasks.blocker: Separate owner authorization and a real-machine evidence receipt required

Research helps provider-choice plan; original acceptance separately assessed.
Human selection does not magically certify optional local AI judges.

Alpha scoring gold references remain separate evidence.
One batch cannot guarantee acceptance of all difficult materials.

adopted_from: owner instruction 2026-10-19: one canonical product roadmap and preserved historical evidence

historical_archive.note: immutable v1 baseline; read-only heritage, not competing active scores

migration_integrity.carried_forward_policy: All 43 originally verified v1 unit-level engineering receipts are carried into the one active roadmap as scope-limited verified tasks. This does not satisfy new, stricter research, real-GPU, paid-provider, LoRA or human image-acceptance gates. Original evidence URLs and original unit IDs are checked against immutable v1.
migration_integrity.inherited_only_verification: Previously accepted original contract, not new product usability certification.

completion_rule: One canonical 63-task register: 43 verified inherited implementation receipts plus 20 proposed v2-specific research/experiment/acceptance tasks. Every unit counted once. Task % expresses evidence-gated engineering work, NOT independently accepted image capability; milestone % expresses verified outcome gates. Both come from this same JSON and are shown by priority/workstream.
